subject: gk
question: _______ means avoiding imports of goods which could be produced in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Self-reliance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Self-reliance refers to the ability of a country to produce essential goods and services domestically, minimizing dependency on imports.
 
• It aims to strengthen the economic independence of a nation by supporting local industries and reducing the trade deficit.
 
• India has emphasized self-reliance through initiatives like "Make in India," which encourages companies to manufacture their products within the country.
 
• Self-reliance is also linked to national security, as it ensures that critical supplies are available without dependency on foreign nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat**:

 
 
• Launched by the Indian government in 2020, Atmanirbhar Bharat aims to make India a self-reliant nation.
 
• The initiative focuses on boosting local manufacturing, promoting local products, and reducing import reliance.
 
• It includes measures for various sectors, including agriculture, defense, and MSMEs (Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises).
 
 
 
• **Import Substitution**:
 
 
• This economic policy advocates replacing foreign imports with domestic production.
 
• It aims to reduce foreign dependency and improve local industry by providing incentives and protections.
 
 
 
• **Economic Growth**:
 
 
• Economic growth refers to an increase in the production of goods and services in an economy over a period of time.
 
• It is measured by the growth in Gross Domestic Product (GDP).
 
 
 
• **Modernisation**:
 
 
• Modernisation involves updating and improving infrastructure, technology, and processes.
 
• It aims to enhance efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness in the global market.
